evidence: No active vog source: Kilauea not erupting/paused ADVISORY YELLOW and Mauna Loa NORMAL GREEN not erupting at image time, so sustained vog plume unlikely. [E2]
No wildfire source: FIRMS shows zero fire clusters in Hawaii box on 2026-08-22, only Kilauea-summit volcanic thermal glow. [E3]

Transport story fails: measured drift toward 23 deg at 32.4 km/h (R2 0.89) vs 10-m wind from 86 deg (blowing toward 266 deg) differs by ~117 deg, well beyond 45 deg agreement, lowering confidence in vog/smoke transport. [E1, E5]

kilauea.activity_summary: Kīlauea volcano is not erupting; the summit eruption in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused. Data indicate the onset of the next fountaining episode is likely between August 22 and August 27. Overview: The summit eruption of Kīlauea in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in July, while the summit region showed patterns of slight inflation. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 57 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the July reporting period, after 94 in June. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
